notes:
v4.6.111 — Equity chart timeframes + full IBKR account value

📈 The bot equity/performance chart now actually responds to the timeframe selector: pick 1W or 1M and it re-pulls and draws the full week/month instead of staying on the last day. Trade-event markers are also clipped to the visible window, so old trades no longer stretch the x-axis and squash a 1-day curve into the corner.

💰 The Overview now shows your FULL IBKR account value (all bots PLUS any cash not assigned to a bot) next to BOTS VALUE (the sum of the bot slices). The full figure is snapshotted live by your running bots; it appears once a bot has cycled with the gateway up.

Update via the in-app banner.
